## Design decisions recorded at implementation

Full rulings in ADR-0312; the load-bearing ones:

- **Stage 6b lives in `AssemblyService::assemble`, plan mode
  only.** After ordinary validation succeeds, plan mode runs
  `hh_compiler::compile` over the bound profile coordinates
  through `RegistryProfiles` (the one resolver `plan` and
  `lab.assembly.compile` share — the adapter's home moved
  from `hh-embed` so both planes read identically, CC1/CC7).
  `UnexpressibleSurface → C-PROF-2` error; `PlanError →
  C-PLAN-2`; `NoProfile → C-LINK-2`; compiler-minted
  diagnostics pass through verbatim; a `LinkError`/
  `InvalidDefinition` carrying *no* diagnostics (unresolvable
  coordinate → `version_conflict`, `profile_untested`, etc.)
  surfaces as a stage-6 **warning** carrying the typed kind —
  never a silent pass (CC3), never a pre-empted compile
  refusal (CC10).
- **`bandit` is a conditioned rule.** `RoutingPolicyKind::
  Bandit` requires a complete `AssumptionDebtRecord`
  (`missing_debt_record`, never coerced); reward projects
  through `BanditView` over the declared `task_class` —
  cells never pool; selection is a deterministic argmax with
  a cold-start prior (never an invented score).
- **K6 `marginal` never serves unverified.** Exact hits
  serve; marginal hits need the registered verifier's `pass`
  and then promote; `readers` is a mandatory key member;
  the verifier verdict rides `model.cache.resolved`'s
  `verifier_verdict` durably.
- **`open_session` realizes the `ModelRoleTable`.** The
  `spec.profile_binding` member (role → ProfileRef /
  `intent_ref`-bearing entry) plus the definition's pinned
  `native.profile` produce the table; `configuration_id
  .model_ref` is the table's `semantic_id` (idp/1), the
  manifest records `profile_binding{roles, fallback_used}` +
  `expired_used[]`, `model_profile_ref` carries the resolved
  record's `version_id` (the only spelling `open_run`'s pin
  gate admits), and an expired bound profile without a
  declared `intent_ref` refuses `expired_without_intent`.

- `check-build-memory.sh` — 0 violations (BM-ADR-04

Two implementation-round regressions were caught and fixed
in-run before closeout: `hh acp --profile` still emitted the
pre-AC-R-2.3.3-11 flat `profile_binding` member — now mounts
`{primary: {profile_ref:{profile}}}` (the role→entry map); and
two `assembly_service` fixtures pinned the unresolvable
`sha256:profile` placeholder — they now admit a resolvable
minimal profile so plan/seal parity and batch-dedup assert the
*clean* case (the unresolvable-pin warning leg is
`s5_1_stage6b_unresolvable_coordinate_warns`'s).

Suite highlights (new/extended tests — every one fails if
the behaviour is removed):

- `hh-compiler` — `expiry.rs` unit ×10 (transition fold,
  runway legs, terminal states, payload shape); `probe.rs`
  unit ×4 (`probe_run_id` determinism, bounded regex,

## Deferrals movement

- **DF-S4.16a-1** — **DONE**: the K6 semantic cache +
  mandatory verifier + `readers` scoping + poisoning fixture
  + per-profile `false_hit_rate` land (`hh-context/src/k6.rs`,
  15/15 green). OQ-312's threshold/calibration ratification
  remains the WS-G3/WS-I2/WS-C4 surface — the component
  registers under the declared defaults (ADR-0312 D2).
- **DF-S1.9-2** — progress: stage 6b `C-PROF-2` lands at
  plan time; `profile_binding` gains its realization legs
  (role table, manifest members). Still owed: §5b
  `profile_binding` constraints, organisation layers (C2),
  AC-CC-11 corpus gate.

## Removability

`removability(0…3)` green (serial script run). Every new
surface is additive (CC8): `RoutingPolicyKind::Bandit` is a
sum member, the K6 cache is a `kind = semantic` slot beside
K4/K5, stage 6b is a plan-only pass (a `Seal`-mode assembly
byte-identical to pre-S5.1), and the manifest members are
absent-when-empty by convention. No new crate, no new
feature gate.
